ConversionProposal.description: Offer to define a household conversion; no amounts, since Foodpedia has no default (it would have normalized the line).

CreatePantry.description: C1: body of `POST /v1/pantries`. The name's rule (FV1) is the domain's: 422 `foodventory.invalidName`.

IngredientDetail.description: Q2: one ingredient in the requested locale; long IngredientDetail.Version is sent back as `If-Match`.

IngredientSummary.description: One search result; the name is in the requested locale, English when missing.

PagedOfIngredientSummary.description: One page of a list query, with the total count of matching items (contract `Page<T>`).

PantryList.description: Q1 answer: the household's pantries and how many stock items still wait to be put away.

Restock.description: S1: body of `POST /v1/stock:restock`. Amounts are the domain's (FV4): 422 `foodventory.invalidQuantity`.

SetPantryStorage.description: C3: body of `POST /v1/pantries/{pantryId}:set-storage`; requires `If-Match`. A null storage clears it.

StockItemView.description: One stock item as the API shows it; StockVersion is the ETag of its IngredientStock aggregate.
